defs.def: all the workers employed in an organization considered as a group 全体职工（或雇员）

ex.s: Call the parking staff.
ex.t: 给停车工作人员打电话。

ex.s: The best table in this two-story colonial Thai home offers a window right into the kitchen, where you can see chef Gaggan and his staff in action.
ex.t: 这座两层殖民风格泰式宅邸里最好的桌子有一扇正对厨房的窗，你可以看到加甘主厨及其团队工作的情形。

ex.s: Offer their staff a salary raise.
ex.t: 给员工加薪。

ex.s: are pleased with the airport staff
ex.t: 对机场员工很满意

ex.s: B.Its staff is too talkative.
ex.t: B.工作人员太健谈。

ex.s: She added that she had a line of staff at her door wanting to take the training.
ex.t: 她补充说，门口排了一队员工想要参加这个培训。

defs.def: the people who work at a school, college or university, but who do not teach students （大、中、小学的）管理人员，行政人员

ex.s: The procedure was received among the staff with                 .
ex.t: 该程序在员工中受到                 的欢迎。

ex.s: Upon entering the correct zone, parking staff will guide you directly to a space.
ex.t: 一旦进入正确的区域，停车管理员会直接引导你到车位。

ex.s: It hires staff from India.
ex.t: 它雇用来自印度的员工。

ex.s: Staff in care homes have reported a reduction in the use of medicine where hens are in use.
ex.t: 养老院的工作人员报告说，在有母鸡的地方，药物用量减少了。

ex.s: It is calculated that European railways alone spend approximately 20 billion euros a year on maintenance, including sending maintenance staff, often at night, to inspect and repair the rail infrastructure.
ex.t: 这可能是危险的工作，如果有无人机协助工作人员就可以避免这种危险。

ex.s: Staff members hold plenty of bar events for guests like free shots, bar crawls and karaoke.
ex.t: 工作人员为客人举办很多酒吧活动，如免费酒水、酒吧巡游和卡拉OK。

ex.s: I do know how upset the shop staff can get, but I try to persuade them to keep   47  .
ex.t: 我知道店员们会多么心烦，但我努力说服他们保持   47  。

ex.s: •If a smoke detector sets off an alarm and there is no fire or smoke， inform your hall staff．
ex.t: •如果烟雾探测器发出警报但没有火灾或烟雾，通知宿舍工作人员。

ex.s: A． contact the hall staff regularly
ex.t: A．定期联系楼层管理员

ex.s: On a typical day, we spend our time cheering up patients, their families, and more often than not, the hospital staff, too!
ex.t: 在一个典型的日子里，我们会花时间为患者、他们的家人以及医院工作人员欢呼雀跃！

ex.s: Interlibrary Loan (ILL) provides teachers, students and staff with access to books that are checked out or not owned by our own libraries, as well as digitized copies of articles and book chapters from our collection.
ex.t: 30多岁时，我结交了一些画家朋友，学会了欣赏艺术的新视角。

ex.s: Current students, teachers (including retired) and staff can request items through ILL.
ex.t: 在校学生、教师（含退休）和员工可通过ILL申请物品。

ex.s: But he is also working at a far more fundamental level: his staff show people how to make floating gardens and fish ponds prevent starvation during the wet season.
ex.t: 但是,他也在更根本的层面上工作:他的工作人员向人们展示如何在潮湿的季节使漂浮的花园和鱼塘防止饥饿。

ex.s: School staff and student volunteers will show new students around the school, and "the new students will get their schedules and find out where their classrooms are".
ex.t: 学校工作人员和学生志愿者将向学校周围的新生展示， “新生将得到他们的时间表，并找出他们的教室在哪里”。

ex.s: Its field staff in Africa oversee a range of grassroots conservation projects, all of them aimed at addressing the key threats facing gorillas today.
ex.t: 其驻非洲的实地工作人员监管一系列基层保护项目，所有这些项目都旨在应对当今大猩猩面临的主要威胁。

ex.s: Consisting of 62 people, it not only included rescuers and medical staff, but also included earthquake experts.
ex.t: 这个团队由 62 人组成，不仅包括救援人员和医务人员，还包括地震专家。

defs.def: a group of senior army officers who help a commanding officer （军队的）全体参谋人员

ex.s: With me today is Lin Feng, a staff member working here.
ex.t: 今天和我在一起的是林峰，这里的一名工作人员。

defs.def: a long stick used as a support when walking or climbing, as a weapon, or as a symbol of authority 拐杖；棍棒；权杖

ex.s: The staff is friendly and helpful, providing you with a map of the city when you arrive, and offering advice if you require some.
ex.t: 工作人员是友好和有帮助的,为您提供到达时的城市地图,如果您需要一些建议,也会提供建议.

ex.s: The procedure appealed to the staff a lot when it was introduced in January. fc6It spread like wildfire that someone from France was here to train the technologists," Ms L'Ecuyer said.
ex.t: 这套程序今年一月推出时很受员工欢迎。“有个法国人来这里培训技术员的消息像野火一样传开了，”勒库耶女士说。

defs.def: a set of five lines on which music is written 五线谱
